title: Guidance Model
text: Reduced-order model for UAV, 2 inputs, 1 output; {ModelType} sets the uAV guidance model, {DataType} sets the input and output numeric data, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Initial State} sets the initial UAV state tab multiple table, {Configuration} sets the uAV controller configuration tab multiple table and {Input/Output Bus Names} sets the simulink bus signal names tab multiple entries of character. Values come from the instance.

params.name: ModelType
params.values: UAV guidance model type MultirotorGuidance (default) | FixedWingGuidance

params.name: DataType
params.values: Input and output numeric data types double (default) | single

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Initial State
params.values: Initial UAV state tab multiple table entries

params.name: Configuration
params.values: UAV controller configuration tab multiple table entries

params.name: Input/Output Bus Names
params.values: Simulink bus signal names tab multiple entries of character vectors
